'''Ellam''', known professionally as '''Honest Ellam''', was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned, four-armed [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who owned [[Honest Ellam's Speeder Lot]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gralleenya]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. Hailing from a smaller planet, he found Questal's [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] uncomfortable, and used an [[anti-grav chair]] for movement.
